review.comment: Core gate logic handles the three main allow/deny cases, and you reject non-boolean hasId strings. After ERROR you keep running, so 25/yes prints ERROR then DENIED. Age uses > 18 not >= 18, and invalid ages like abc or negatives slip through as DENIED. Next: return after ERROR, validate age with Number.isInteger and age >= 0, then use age >= 18 && hasId === "true".

All acceptance criteria pass: gate uses && with age >= 18 and hasId literal checks, and invalid input prints ERROR then returns. Age validation with Number.isInteger and age >= 0 covers non-numeric, negative, and decimal ages. Clear improvement from your first submission. Solid match to the logical operators lesson and README.
